welcome.title: Welcome 👋
welcome.body: This is your shopping list. Add items by voice through Siri or manually, and share the list with your household.

addItems.title: Adding items 🎙️
addItems.body: Tell Siri "add milk to the list", or type it manually — the item is added and auto-categorized. You can also set a quantity and unit, and check it off once bought.

search.title: Quick search 🔍
search.body: Search for an item in the list, and if it's not there yet — add it straight from the search box.

organize.title: Organized by category 🗂
organize.body: The list is automatically split into categories, so it's easy to know what to grab on each aisle.

lists.title: Multiple lists, your way 📋
lists.body: Everyone has their own list. Invite family members to edit it, switch between lists, and even import a whole list by pasting it in.

stock.title: Track your stock 📦
stock.body: The "Stock" tab tracks quantities at home. Low items are highlighted, and one tap adds them to the shopping list.

receipts.title: Scan receipts 🧾
receipts.body: Photograph a receipt or paste a link to a digital invoice — items and prices are extracted automatically, once you confirm them.
